verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, not a software platform, so registrable outbound HTTP webhooks are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers legal practice areas and a Clerky partnership, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Nothing shows the firm itself ships any event-subscription or webhook capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
